description: Retrieve Google search results programmatically. Supports web search, images, news, videos, and maps with customizable location, language, and device settings.

location.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for geographic location (e.g., 'us', 'uk', 'fr'). Default: 'us'

page.description: Results page number for pagination. Default: 1

results_count.description: Maximum number of results per page (1-100). Default: 10

search.description: Search query term (provide this OR 'url' parameter, not both)

url.description: Direct Google search page URL (provide this OR 'search' parameter, not both)

name: ujeebu_serp
